browser.timingDefinition: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.
browser.qualification: Actual UI flows use their recorded solve settings. Native ten-second corpus timings are separate; this does not establish a universal ten-second browser latency.

visualReview.review: Assistant visual inspection of saved Chromium screenshots
visualReview.scope: UI rendering and obvious motif/contour defects. Numeric acceptance is separately recorded; this is not exact artwork or physical assembly verification.

observations.flower-native-mask: Six petals retained; small centre contour irregularities and a faint thin seam near an upper petal remain.
observations.flower-downsample-mask: Petals retained; small centre and outline irregularities remain.
observations.hard-bibel-star-outline: Star and border retained; rounded or uneven ends and minor protrusions remain.
observations.hard-bibel-star-outline-half: Central notches and jagged contour sections remain visible.
observations.hard-bibel-star-outline-jpeg75: Motif retained; small border distortions remain.
observations.hard-flettede-puppy: Eye opening and body retained; contour irregularities remain.
observations.hard-flettede-viking: Sail and hull retained; thin parallel white seams and protrusions remain along portions of the frame.
observations.hunodan: Bell retained; rounded outline follows the photographic target.
observations.star: Straight five-point star is visually clean; matching-template result is shown.
observations.top-hat-preferred: Hat and matching templates retained; free-border changes are reported; minor contour nicks remain.
observations.blue-star-polishing-mask: Four-point outlined star and border retained; small steps and bumps remain at inner corners.
observations.web-danish-tree-green: Tree silhouette retained; branch tips and trunk junction have small irregularities.
observations.gold-routing-mask: Angel and surrounding ring retained; rounded stroke ends and small contour irregularities remain.

visualReview.ui: All thirteen result screenshots render the motif and active Open in Draw / Back to the mask actions without black-box rendering failures. Both inspected Draw screenshots show editable coloured outlines and export actions without an intersection warning.
visualReview.remainingReviewLimits: Not every individual cutting path has been manually inspected; paper checks are nominal geometric checks.

errorIncreaseReview.scope: Independent raster comparison against the unchanged classified mask. Changed pixels and net error increases are different measures; this does not prove the precise cause of every geometric difference.
